stem: Let $f$ and $g$ be two real valued functions such that $g(x)=f(x)-2$. Select all true options.
options: If $f$ is odd, then $g$ is odd.
If $f$ is even, then $g$ is even.
If $g$ is odd, then $f$ is odd.
If $g$ is even, then $f$ is even.
reason: mismatch: key D only, but B is also true
derivation: $f$ even gives $g(-x)=f(-x)-2=f(x)-2=g(x)$, so B is true; $g$ even gives $f(-x)=g(-x)+2=g(x)+2=f(x)$, so D is true. A and C fail (a constant shift breaks oddness). True options: B and D.

stem: Define a function $f$ as follows: $f(x)=\begin{cases}kx^2+l, & \text{if } x\le1\\ 1x^2+kx+m, & \text{if } x>1\end{cases}$. If $f$ is continuous and differentiable at $x=1$ find the value of $k-2l+m$. ______.
reason: underdetermined: k-2l+m = -m, m not fixed; PDF key 0 not derivable
derivation: Differentiability: $2k=2+k$, so $k=2$. Continuity: $k+l=1+k+m$, so $l=1+m$. Then $k-2l+m=2-2-2m+m=-m$, which depends on the free parameter $m$; it equals $0$ only if $m=0$. Underdetermined as printed.

stem: Suppose the number of visitors arriving at a zoo can be modeled to be Poisson distributed. On an average 20 visitors arrive per hour. Let $X$ be the number of visitors arriving from 2pm to 4pm. Then the probability that at least 35 visitors will arrive in the given duration is:
reason: mismatch: options C and D are mathematically identical and both correct; key lists only D
derivation: Two hours at 20/hour gives rate 40. $P(X\ge35)=\sum_{k\ge35}e^{-40}40^k/k!=1-\sum_{k=0}^{34}e^{-40}40^k/k!$, so both C and D are correct (identical value); the question is single-answer, key D.

stem: The average diameter of pipes manufactured by a company is reported to be 25mm, which you suspect to be too low. You observed a random sample of diameters of 10 pipes (in mm) as 24.58, 24.67, 24.99, 25.22, 25.32, 25.25, 24.96, 24.87, 25.52, 24.85. Based on this information, what conclusion can you reach about your suspicion at significance level of 5%? Use $F_{t_9}^{-1}(0.95)=1.833$.
reason: mismatch: t = +0.243 is not below -1.833, so H0 is not rejected; key says Reject
derivation: $H_0:\mu=25$ vs $H_1:\mu<25$. Sample mean $=25.023$, $s=0.2990$, $t=(25.023-25)/(0.2990/\sqrt{10})=0.243$. The rejection region is $t<-1.833$; $0.243$ is not in it, so $H_0$ is not rejected (option A). The key B (reject) disagrees.
